rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer Meta block states 'Mood target: grounded competence — "I can feel when a plan is good before approving it, and I know the move is two reads, not one."' verbatim-matching content-strategy.md L305. Big Idea ('Reading a plan is finite... Paired, they give a complete read; neither alone does') embodies the mood and mirrors the strategy doc's retrospective naming almost verbatim (L313: 'One kind of scrutiny catches one kind of miss... paired, they give the complete read'). 'Next' section states the setup for M3 in one sentence ('the same move goes into durable infrastructure... before a teammate needs to ask'), satisfying the state+setup requirement.

Rule fires when module's contracted mood is 'unease'; M2's mood is 'grounded competence,' not unease, so the trigger condition is absent. Checked regardless: 'Start here' opens on curious self-diagnosis ('What made you approve? Was it that the plan looked right, or that you were in a hurry...') — epistemic register, no shame/blame language anywhere in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode
rules_evaluated.evidence: Big Idea and all 7 Key Concepts bullets lead with positive disciplines (structure-skepticism, paired-scrutiny, assumption-naming, decision-specificity, gate-vs-decoration, plan-quality-is-the-work). Failure vocabulary (rubber-stamp, softening, approval inflation) appears only inside the maintainer/trainer push-back tables, never as a student-facing bullet's lead. WYL's 'Spot approval inflation in your own past plans' uses the failure as the discipline-verb's object (sanctioned carve-out), not as the bullet's title.

Cross-checked against content-strategy.md M2 section point by point: file never names 'Skill' as a Claude Code primitive, Pocock, or grill-me — preserves M3's first-Skill-use + skill-reveal (L311). WYL says 'Push back twice,' matching the doc's explicit refusal of a three-push-back quota (L315). KC bullet 'Making it good IS the work' matches the doc's explicit plan-execution refusal (L315). 'How instructions grow' lecture's Argyris/Schön double-loop is the doc-specified M2 closer (L321), not borrowed from later. 'Pre-reads before Module 3' (Willison lethal trifecta + optional OWASP scan) matches the doc's M2→M3 gap pre-read spec exactly (L353-356) — correct placement, not early teaching. 'STRIDE, the six-category threat walk' appears only as a forward-bridge name in the Next section, without teaching STRIDE's categories (sanctioned 'module names in tail' carve-out, §7c). File correctly omits M1's ticket-conventions/refinement content (already maintainer-accepted).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategic themes recur in Key Concepts
rules_evaluated.evidence: Against the compendium's own canonical six-theme list (90%-correct/compounding/mirror/self-awareness/capture-your-world/non-agentic-default): bullet 1 ('Structure is persuasive... Assume about 10% of it is wrong and go find which part') is a direct 90%-correct instance; bullet 3's closer ('Push-backs ship into memory') is a direct capture-your-world instance (echoing content-strategy L116's 'every pushback... is one more thing the system now knows about your world') with compounding overlap via the memory-compounds terminology. Two clean instances meet the ≥2 floor. The task's alternate 7-verb list (Compound/Earn/Mirror/Ground/Introspect/Sharpen/Capture) is §7's WYL-verb-register rule, not this rule's theme-instance test; evaluated separately under rule 7.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Key Concepts shape — breadcrumbs, gates first
rules_evaluated.evidence: §§3/4/5 gates re-run clean per above. One breadcrumb present ('Push-backs ship into memory' — 4 words, no bold, no 'Remember:' label, engineer register) within the 1-3 range floor. The '10% wrong' bullet's current wording is the maintainer-block-accepted, already-corrected form of the compendium's own canonical example (recorded 2026-08-02 in-file) — not a fresh finding. Task-flagged bullet ('A plan with a specific file list has made decisions... The deferred ones get made mid-run, where a wrong call propagates across files and tangles.') stays discipline-led: first sentence is the positive claim, second sentence is the sanctioned failure-as-consequence (§3's own carve-out: 'failure mode becomes negative case the discipline addresses, not the title'), not failure-as-headline. Stays emergent-from-doing: it ties directly to Exercise 2's walk-down-unresolved-branches move and sits in the after-the-work Key Concepts section per the module's structure, not lectured beforehand.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: What You'll Learn shape — capability register
rules_evaluated.evidence: §§3/4 gates re-verified clean. All 7 bullets are verb+immediate-object, peer-Slack register ('Run plan mode on a real multi-file task...', 'Extract task-shaping rules from your session into a .md file'). No Bloom-tag parentheticals, no pedagogical-mechanism tails, no author-defence asides, no didactic taxonomy stamps. 'Pair human read with agent walk-down: read → push-back → walk-down → approve' correctly uses a construction/pairing verb for a concrete sequence-artifact, matching the sanctioned Build/Pair/Match/Assemble register rather than the flagged academic 'Recognise...as a repeatable design pattern' failure mode. None of the seven bullets happens to lead with one of the cross-training theme-verbs (Compound/Earn/Mirror/Ground/Introspect/Sharpen/Capture); the compendium states these verbs 'land as bullet verbs across training' descriptively, not as a per-module quota, so this is a non-blocking observation, not a violation — the module's own verbs are correctly scoped to M2's actual moves.
